caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a trivet or similar utensil support. It has a pointed, shield-like triangular shape with ornate, symmetrical openwork patterns featuring swirling, curved lines and shapes reminiscent of hearts and spirals. The object appears to be made of metal, suggested by its uniform brown coloration and slight shading for depth and texture. The handle is cylindrical and textured with diagonal grooves, and it has two circular holes: one at the base where the handle attaches to the main body, and one at the end of the handle. The trivet-like object rests on three short, rounded legs, elevating its main, decorated surface above the ground. The drawing is rendered against a plain, light background, and the name "PAUL PUFFENBARGER" is printed in small capital letters in the lower right corner.
title: Trivet
